_doc: The parameter side of openHC's own program (program.json), for the firmware
file adau1451-ea3-openhc.bin. See README.md in this directory.
The image build makes it only when CI built the program, and installs it
beside adau1451-ea3.bin; the device tree still names that one, so this
file is not loaded at boot yet. The register init is ea3.json's. Cells are
named by block label and parameter (params.json, from the same export), so
they follow the design wherever SigmaStudio+ puts them.
Volume is the program's stereo gain, linear 8.24 per channel; it is written
0 at boot, so nothing plays until something raises it. Version is the
program's version cell, for the driver's check.
